import re
path = Path('source/fitz/load-bmp.c')
data = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

# Patch the second truncated-data check using a simpler literal replace of the current block.
old = "\tif (ssp + sstride * height > end)\n\t{\n\t\tfz_warn(ctx, \"premature end in bitmap data in bmp image\");\n\t\theight = (end - ssp) / sstride;\n\t}\n"

    raise SystemExit('Second block literal not found')
